purpose: Map frozen Macro Core series to official release mechanisms so observation-period histories can be converted into market-availability histories without generic guessed lags.

policy.pit_timestamp_rule: An observation becomes usable no earlier than its official public release time/date. When exact historical timestamps are unavailable, mark the observation or series WITHHELD_PIT rather than invent a lag.
policy.vintage_rule: Use first-public-release values where an official real-time/vintage archive exists. If only revised history is available, keep REVISED_ONLY and do not call the series full PIT.
policy.timezone_rule: Preserve source-local release time and normalize to UTC only in the final historical panel.
policy.revision_rule: A revised value may enter only on the revision publication date; it must not overwrite the value that was known before that date in a PIT replay.

agencies.official_release_mechanism: Personal Income and Outlays release schedule and dated historical releases
agencies.verified_example: December 2025 released 2026-02-20; release page explicitly notes revisions to prior months.

agencies.official_release_mechanism: BLS release calendar / dated Employment Situation and JOLTS releases

agencies.verified_example: 2026 monthly release dates are published by the Board; previous releases and historical release dates are available.

agencies.official_release_mechanism: Economic Indicator Release Schedule plus program-specific historical release dates
agencies.verified_example: Advance Monthly Retail Trade schedule maps each data month to an exact release date/time; Census also exposes historical release dates.

agencies.verified_example: Calendar provides indicator-specific releases and uses Europe/Luxembourg timezone; 2026 calendar is published and weekly planning is confirmed.

agencies.agency: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry
agencies.official_release_mechanism: Monthly list of presentation dates and preliminary/revised releases
agencies.verified_example: METI lists preliminary and revised presentation dates/times and explicitly distinguishes revised reports and annual adjustments.

agencies.official_release_mechanism: FSO release/press-release archive and dataset metadata
verified_examples: Retail Trade Turnover metadata states provisional results are published one month after the survey period and final results five months after.
Employment-barometer quality documentation states quarterly aggregated results are disseminated within less than 60 days.

agencies.official_release_mechanism: Exact source series in runtime must be matched to its release archive before PIT promotion.
The Daily dated releases and annual release-date calendar
verified_examples: Statistics Canada publishes a 2026-2027 release-date calendar.
Statistics Canada exposes historical real-time retail and GDP tables for some series.

agencies.official_release_mechanism: ABS release calendar with reference period, exact date and local release time
verified_examples: Monthly Household Spending August 2026 released 2026-09-29 11:30 AEST.
Wage Price Index September 2026 appears on the November 2026 release calendar.
Labour market statistics June 2026 quarter released 2026-08-05.
Retail trade survey June 2026 quarter released 2026-08-25.

current_assessment.reason: The official release channels are now identified, but exact historical release-date/vintage mapping has not yet been materialized for every one of the 55 active Core Macro series.
current_assessment.positive_change: We no longer need to guess generic lags. Each currency now has an official release mechanism to anchor the reconstruction.

next_actions: Create per-series mapping from each of the 55 Core Macro IDs to agency/release family.
Extract exact historical release dates for the common backtest window, prioritizing 2019-2026.
Exploit official real-time tables where available (notably Statistics Canada retail/GDP) rather than reconstructing vintages manually.
Mark series REVISED_ONLY where first-release vintage values cannot be recovered and quantify how much of the Macro Core remains usable without them.
After the PIT date map is complete, compute the earliest common full-G8 Macro checkpoint and coverage by checkpoint.
